headline: Bitcoin steadies near $81k amid consolidation and liquidity hunt
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC is holding the 80.5k–81k range, respecting the 80.2k support and testing the 81.2k resistance; the 4H structure shows a descending channel intact, suggesting limited upside until a breakout.
altcoin_summary: Capital is rotating into high‑momentum altcoins, with CELR, G, ONE and BANK leading gains as traders seek risk‑on exposure away from BTC.
strategy_outlook: Spot: add to positions on dips near $80,200 with tight stops; Futures: stay flat or short‑biased, targeting a retest of $81,500 if price breaks above resistance.
